integrity: Original published results distinguished explicitly; reproduced finite experiments reported as corroboration. No external independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Regular Euclidean polygons only; phase-coupled directional process under natural angular scaling. A previously published projected-edge moment kernel permits finite covariance computations, and the published pre-edge identity covers the odd-to-double-even relation. The novel assertion is the full coupled functional limit and universal sharp anticorrelation. Unindexed equivalent results remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Universal anticorrelation and the functional width-fluctuation limit for regular polygons
